summary: Created a 4-phase plan for the typescript extension's nested-project detection defect the research phase exposed. Re-validated both carried figures live before planning: sf1-engine still has 86 *.test.ts suites, no tsconfig, ESM, no root package.json, and the deployed hook run from the repo root still prints the SKIP that fails the PASS CONDITION. Phases: (1) bounded, vendor-excluded package.json fallback search inside typescript-verify.sh with aggregated path-prefixed findings; (2) the extension's first regression suite plus the derived manifest provides.scripts sync; (3) prose-doc sync plus the derived index-entries.json line_count regeneration; (4) live re-validation against sf1-engine with a mechanical HARD-CONSTRAINT grep, and the full gate set. Every edit stays inside agent-system/extensions/typescript/.
